title: Three push paths for call start — no dedup rule
description: VTC spec line 1282: room/scheduled call notifications should use ChatMessagePush. But a room call start also triggers: (1) Chat StateChange for activeCallId, (2) ChatMessagePush if server auto-posts 'call started' message, (3) VTC StateChange for new VTCCall. Three push paths for one event, no deduplication rule. Clients may show 3 notifications.
